set.body:
Scope

Promote the duplicated design/fit scenario result machinery into one portable test-support authority while keeping numeric adapters local to the modules that own their matrix types.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ScenarioStatus, caveat policy, observations, tolerances, and ScenarioResult have one shared cross-built implementation.
- [ ] Design and fit retain small typed adapters for their respective matrix/vector representations without introducing a production dependency cycle.
- [ ] Existing active scenarios preserve behavior and still return one ScenarioResult truth value.
- [ ] Clean Pass remains the default CI-acceptable state; PassWithCaveats requires an explicit scenario policy; blocking caveats and failed observations cannot pass.
- [ ] A manifest validator rejects duplicate IDs, missing suite/fixture/exporter paths, unsupported platforms, empty acceptance commands, undeclared statuses, and inconsistent external-reference metadata.
- [ ] A versioned receipt schema covers generator identity, versions/revisions, numerical conventions, hashes, and accepted differences.
- [ ] The current external fixture is represented by that schema.
- [ ] Testkit and every migrated scenario pass on JVM and Scala.js.
- [ ] Production artifacts do not acquire MUnit or testkit dependencies.
set.title: P0.3: consolidate the scenario testkit, manifest validator, and receipt schema
